dialogues.speaker: Homayun
dialogues.text: How rare. He's been absorbed in research and barely shows up around here.

dialogues.speaker: Homayun
dialogues.text: If it weren't for the fact that he's a candidate for the next Grand Conservator, even fewer young researchers would know about him.

dialogues.speaker: Homayun
dialogues.text: I prefer him though, compared to that Vikram fellow. Rifaet is more like a researcher in my opinion.

dialogues.speaker: Homayun
dialogues.text: But I don't know what those sages think. After all, they're the ones who have the final say.
